I interviewed for a Security Researcher role and successfully cleared two technical interview rounds. 💻🔒

After that, I was rejected because my PPT presentation skills didn’t meet their expectations. 🤷‍♂️ If presentation skills are the deciding factor, that should be communicated from the very beginning.

AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex can help create polished presentations in minutes. The real value of a security researcher is the ability to think critically, identify vulnerabilities, and understand complex security issuesskills that should carry more weight in a technical interview.

I also found the HR interaction unprofessional. When I asked how many candidates were being interviewed, instead of receiving a straightforward answer, I was asked, “Why do you want to know that?” 🤔
